description: This file provides a set of functions for managing device documents in a MongoDB collection, including creation, retrieval, updating, deletion, and collection setup with validation and indexing.

methods.name: _get_client
methods.description: Initializes and returns a singleton MongoClient instance.

methods.name: get_collection
methods.description: Retrieves the MongoDB collection, creating it with validation and indexes if necessary.

methods.name: _normalize_dates
methods.description: Converts 'last_ping_time' from ISO string to datetime object for database storage.

methods.name: _serialize_device
methods.description: Serializes a MongoDB document into a JSON-friendly dictionary, converting ObjectId and datetime fields.

methods.name: _parse_object_id
methods.description: Converts a string to an ObjectId, raising an error if invalid.

methods.name: insert_device
methods.description: Inserts a new device document into the collection and returns its ID.

methods.name: find_devices
methods.description: Finds devices matching a filter with optional sorting and pagination.

methods.name: update_device
methods.description: Updates multiple devices matching a filter with a specified update document.

methods.name: delete_device
methods.description: Deletes devices matching a filter and returns the count.

methods.name: get_by_id
methods.description: Retrieves a single device by its ObjectId string.

methods.name: replace_one_by_id
methods.description: Replaces a device document identified by its ObjectId.

methods.name: update_one_by_id
methods.description: Applies a partial update to a device identified by its ObjectId.

methods.name: delete_one_by_id
methods.description: Deletes a device by its ObjectId.
